scenes.heading: Security & Governance in Warehouses
scenes.narration: Warehouses hold your most sensitive data, so layered access control, masking, and auditing are non-negotiable.

scenes.heading: The pillars of governance
bullets: Role-based access control grants privileges to roles, not individuals.
Row and column policies restrict which data each user actually sees.
Encryption protects data at rest and in transit by default.
Audit logs record who queried what, and when, for compliance.
scenes.narration: Role-based access control assigns privileges to roles that users inherit, which keeps permissions manageable. Fine-grained policies then mask columns and filter rows so people see only what they should. Encryption is on by default, and audit logs give you the accountability that regulations demand.

scenes.heading: How a privileged query is evaluated
scenes.narration: When a user runs a query, the warehouse first checks whether their active role may access the table. A row access policy then removes rows the user is not entitled to see. Finally masking policies obscure sensitive columns, so the same query returns different results depending on who runs it.

scenes.heading: Coarse vs fine-grained control

right.title: Fine-grained
points: Dynamic based on the querying role

scenes.narration: Coarse control only lets you grant or deny entire tables, which often forces you to duplicate data for special cases. Fine-grained policies apply logic at the row and column level so a single table safely serves many audiences. Because the policies are dynamic, the same table adapts automatically to whoever is querying it.

scenes.heading: Masking a sensitive column
scenes.code:
-- Show full email only to the PII_ADMIN role
CREATE MASKING POLICY email_mask AS
  (val STRING) RETURNS STRING ->
  CASE
    WHEN CURRENT_ROLE() = 'PII_ADMIN' THEN val
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(val, '.+@', '****@')
  END;

ALTER TABLE customers MODIFY COLUMN email
  SET MASKING POLICY email_mask;
scenes.narration: This masking policy inspects the current role at query time. Privileged PII administrators see the real email address, while everyone else sees it partially redacted. Attaching the policy to the email column enforces the rule automatically for every query, with no changes to application code.

scenes.text: Layer RBAC, row and column policies, encryption, and auditing so sensitive data is protected and every access is accountable.
scenes.narration: Combine role-based access, dynamic policies, encryption, and audit logs, and your warehouse stays both secure and compliant.
